proposals.evidence_summary: Tokyo Electron states that export sales are in principle denominated in yen; although some sales and expenses are denominated in foreign currencies, the impact of exchange-rate fluctuations on profits is negligible unless extreme fluctuations occur. The current Phase-8F fx context is EUR/USD-only, so no relationship-specific mapping is promoted from this evidence.
